propositions: On the agentic execution path, tool-result message history is re-sent uncached every turn, causing input costs to grow O(N^2) with accumulated turns rather than being cached

The cache_settings_for function currently sets only anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions, leaving anthropic_cache and anthropic_cache_messages unused despite both being available in pydantic-ai
The telemetry signal warn_if_cache_ineffective cannot detect this inefficiency because the system block hits cache, making cache_read_tokens nonzero and preventing the detection predicate from firing

Anthropic and Bedrock have asymmetric cache-control APIs and require different keys: Bedrock rejects top-level cache_control but accepts bedrock_cache_messages, whereas Anthropic needs anthropic_cache for automatic multi-turn caching
Single-turn non-agentic execution paths must remain byte-identical to avoid regression, as they are not affected by multi-turn message accumulation
